meta.title: Fieldnote Interactive demo
meta.description: Filterable post grid and save-for-later reading list built with the WordPress Interactivity API, running on the Fieldnote block theme.
meta.author: jdyach

Block themes move layout decisions out of PHP and into data, which changes who can make them: designers and editors, not only developers.

Start from theme.json

Every color, size and space on this site comes from a preset. Change one value in Global Styles and it updates everywhere it is used.

Design tokens are a contract between the designer and the editor.

Studio notebook
'; $titles = array( 'Why we moved every client to block themes', 'A fluid type scale you can actually reason about', 'Section styles: color schemes without custom CSS', 'Writing patterns editors will not break', 'What theme.json replaced in our old functions.php', 'Notes on handing off a site to a non-developer', 'Designing for the person who edits the site next', 'Patterns, not page builders', 'A checklist for accessible color schemes', 'Prefetching: making clicks feel instant', 'What we learned shipping six block themes', 'The smallest useful functions.php', ); foreach ( $titles as $i => $title ) { $post_id = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => $title, 'post_content' => $body, 'post_excerpt' => 'A short write-up from the studio on building maintainable WordPress sites with blocks, presets and patterns.', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_date' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - ( $i + 1 ) * 4 * DAY_IN_SECONDS ), 'post_category' => array( $categories[ $i % 3 ] ), ) ); if ( $images ) { set_post_thumbnail( $post_id, $images[ $i % count( $images ) ] ); } } // Landing page built from the Fieldnote theme's page pattern, when available. $landing_content = ''; $home = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => 'Home', 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'menu_order' => 1, 'post_content' => $landing_content, 'page_template' => 'page-landing', ) ); $explore = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_title' => 'Explore', 'post_name' => 'explore', 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'menu_order' => 0, 'post_content' => '

Filter by topic and page through posts without a reload. Save anything to your reading list.
